basic.name: Overkill
basic.description: Deal 552~~0.04~~ damage to the target and 276~~0.04~~ damage to nearby targets over 4 seconds. Reactivate to select a new target or direction. Can move and use Abilities while Channeling.

basic.name: Frag Grenade
basic.description: Lob a grenade that deals 256~~0.04~~ damage, knocking enemies away.

basic.name: Overkill Retarget
basic.description: Focuses Overkill on a different target or direction.

basic.name: Annihilate
basic.description: Fire the Odin's cannons in a straight line, dealing 196~~0.04~~ damage to everything in the path.

basic.name: Ragnarok Missiles
basic.description: Launches a volley of missiles at target area, dealing 132~~0.04~~ damage and slowing enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Drakken Laser Drill
heroic.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142~~0.04~~ damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

heroic.name: Commandeer Odin
heroic.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

heroic.name: Laser Drill Issue Order
heroic.description: Order the Laser Drill to attack a new target.

trait.name: Minigun
trait.description: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health. Lasts 3 seconds.

activable.name: Neosteel Coating
activable.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level1.name: Quarterback
level1.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level1.name: Dash
level1.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level1.name: Press the Advantage
level1.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

level4.name: In the Rhythm
level4.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level4.name: The Bigger They Are...
level4.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

level4.name: Master Assassin
level4.description:
Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%. 

Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level7.name: Melting Point
level7.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75~~0.04~~ damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level7.name: Combat Tactician
level7.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

level7.name: Relentless Soldier
level7.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

level10.name: Commandeer Odin
level10.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level10.name: Drakken Laser Drill
level10.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142~~0.04~~ damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

level13.name: Spray 'n' Pray
level13.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level13.name: That's the Stuff!
level13.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

level13.name: Neosteel Coating
level13.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level16.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
level16.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

level16.name: Titan Grenade
level16.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level16.name: Sizzlin' Attacks
level16.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level20.name: Big Red Button
level20.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319~~0.04~~ damage in its area.

level20.name: Focusing Diodes
level20.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

level20.name: Can Do This All Day
level20.description: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds. While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

level20.name: Bob and Weave
level20.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25. After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.
